# vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp

## Overview

[`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1) documents the `glsl.atomic_operations` branch. The file is attached to the GLSL category by [`vktTestPackage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/vktTestPackage.cpp#L1274-L1278), and [`createAtomicOperationTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1589-L1592) creates the `atomic_operations` group whose children are generated by [`addAtomicOperationTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1468-L1585).

The generated cases exercise GLSL atomic built-ins that lower to SPIR-V `OpAtomic*` operations over integer and floating-point data, ordinary storage buffers, workgroup-shared or task-payload storage for eligible stages, and buffer-reference addressing. The source computes expected results on the host and accepts either legal ordering when two shader invocations race on the same `inout` element.

## Role

Registration / dispatcher file and implementation-heavy test file.

## Source Code

- Primary source: [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1)
- Root header: [`vktAtomicOperationTests.hpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.hpp#L23-L35)
- GLSL category registration: [`vktTestPackage.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/vktTestPackage.cpp#L1274-L1278)
- Test-case and instance classes: [`AtomicOperationCase`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1010-L1056) and [`AtomicOperationCaseInstance`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L874-L1008)
- Registration function: [`addAtomicOperationTests()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1468-L1585)

## Test Families

### exchange_* — Atomic exchange across eligible data, stage, and memory variants

The `exchange` family is generated from the `atomicOp[]` entry `{ATOMIC_OP_EXCHANGE, "exchange"}` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1524-L1535). For each permitted data type, shader stage, and memory suffix, the case name is assembled as `exchange_<data>_<stage><suffix>` before constructing an [`AtomicOperationCase`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1573-L1580).

Exchange is one of the atomic operations allowed for both integer and floating-point data. The floating-point filter keeps `ATOMIC_OP_EXCHANGE` while rejecting bitwise and compare-swap operations for floating-point data at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1543-L1557). Host verification for integer exchange accepts either ordering of the two racing operations at [`TestBuffer::checkOperation()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L596-L600), and floating-point exchange uses the same two-ordering model at [`TestBufferFloatingPoint::checkOperationFloatingPoint()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L820-L824).

### comp_swap_* — Integer atomic compare-and-swap

The `comp_swap` family is generated by the `ATOMIC_OP_COMP_SWAP` entry in `atomicOp[]` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1524-L1535). Floating-point data types are skipped for compare-swap by the floating-point operation filter at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1543-L1557), so the direct children use `signed`, `unsigned`, `signed64bit`, and `unsigned64bit` data names.

The buffer initializer chooses compare values so one of the two overlapping invocations matches according to even/odd element index at [`TestBuffer::fillWithTestData()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L301-L319). Verification then builds two acceptable compare-swap outcomes based on that index parity at [`TestBuffer::checkOperation()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L603-L616).

### add_* — Atomic add for integer and supported floating-point data

The `add` family is generated from `{ATOMIC_OP_ADD, "add"}` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1528-L1531). It is available to integer data and remains in the floating-point allow-list at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1543-L1557).

Integer add verification accepts either execution order while requiring the final `inout` value to include both inputs at [`TestBuffer::checkOperation()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L550-L555). Floating-point add uses `floatAdd()` to quiet NaNs and accumulate in either order at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L691-L697) and [`TestBufferFloatingPoint::checkOperationFloatingPoint()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L759-L766).

### min_* and max_* — Atomic min/max with integer ordering and floating-point exceptional values

The `min` and `max` families are registered by the `ATOMIC_OP_MIN` and `ATOMIC_OP_MAX` entries in `atomicOp[]` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1530-L1532). For floating-point data, these operations are present only in non-Vulkan SC builds because the allow-list includes them inside the `#ifndef CTS_USES_VULKANSC` block at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1549-L1553).

Integer min/max expected results use `de::min()` and `de::max()` for the two possible operation orders at [`TestBuffer::checkOperation()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L578-L593). Floating-point min/max expands acceptable outcomes for signaling NaNs, quiet NaNs, and signed zero at [`handleExceptionalFloatMinMaxValues()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L646-L689), then applies those candidates for min at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L768-L792) and max at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L794-L818).

### and_*, or_*, and xor_* — Integer bitwise atomics

The `and`, `or`, and `xor` families are generated from the last three `atomicOp[]` entries at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1532-L1535). The floating-point operation filter excludes these operations for `float16`, `f16vec2`, `f16vec4`, `float32`, and `float64`, so generated bitwise cases use only the signed and unsigned 32-bit and 64-bit integer data names at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1543-L1557).

Host verification computes bitwise `&`, `|`, and `^` results for both legal operation orders at [`TestBuffer::checkOperation()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L557-L576). The comparisons are exact byte comparisons through [`Expected::compare()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L339-L344).

## Parameter Dimensions

| Dimension | Observed values / evidence |
|---|---|
| Atomic operations | `exchange`, `comp_swap`, `add`, `min`, `max`, `and`, `or`, and `xor` come from `atomicOp[]` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1524-L1535). |
| Data types | In non-Vulkan SC builds, `dataSign[]` lists `float16`, `f16vec2`, `f16vec4`, `signed`, `unsigned`, `float32`, `signed64bit`, `unsigned64bit`, and `float64`; the 16-bit floating-point entries are compiled out under `CTS_USES_VULKANSC` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1498-L1522). |
| Shader stages | `shaderTypes[]` lists `vertex`, `fragment`, `geometry`, `tess_ctrl`, `tess_eval`, `compute`, `task`, and `mesh` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1472-L1485). |
| Memory suffixes | `kMemoryTypes[]` maps ordinary buffer storage to no suffix, workgroup shared memory to `_shared`, buffer references to `_reference`, and task payload storage to `_payload` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1487-L1496). |
| Floating-point operation filter | Floating-point data keeps `add`, `exchange`, and, outside Vulkan SC, `min` and `max`; other operations are skipped before case creation at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1543-L1557). |
| Shared-memory stage filter | `_shared` cases are generated only for compute, task, and mesh stages at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1559-L1566), matching the constructor assertion in [`AtomicShaderType`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L77-L84). |
| Payload-memory stage filter | `_payload` cases are generated only for task shaders because mesh-shader task payload is read-only for these atomics at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1568-L1571), matching the constructor assertion in [`AtomicShaderType`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L83-L84). |
| Element count and overlap model | `NUM_ELEMENTS` is `32` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L220-L223); each `inout` array has `NUM_ELEMENTS / 2` entries so two operations target each `inout` element at [`TestBuffer::BufferData`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L272-L283) and [`TestBufferFloatingPoint::BufferDataFloatingPoint`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L388-L399). |
| Shader-generated data type names | GLSL type names are selected with `dataType2Str()` and injected as `${DATATYPE}` into `AtomicStruct` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L240-L246) and [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1306-L1317). |

## Support / Feature Requirements

| Requirement | Evidence |
|---|---|
| 64-bit integer atomics | `DATA_TYPE_INT64` and `DATA_TYPE_UINT64` require `VK_KHR_shader_atomic_int64`, then require `shaderBufferInt64Atomics` for buffer/reference cases or `shaderSharedInt64Atomics` for shared-like cases at [`AtomicOperationCase::checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1058-L1077). |
| 16-bit scalar floating-point atomics | `DATA_TYPE_FLOAT16` requires `VK_EXT_shader_atomic_float2`; non-Vulkan SC builds check operation-specific buffer/shared feature bits for add, min/max, and exchange at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1079-L1143). |
| 16-bit vector floating-point atomics | `DATA_TYPE_FLOAT16X2` and `DATA_TYPE_FLOAT16X4` are non-Vulkan SC entries and require `VK_NV_shader_atomic_float16_vector` plus `shaderFloat16VectorAtomics` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1145-L1154). |
| 32-bit floating-point atomics | `DATA_TYPE_FLOAT32` requires `VK_EXT_shader_atomic_float`; add and exchange check `shader*Float32AtomicAdd` or `shader*Float32Atomics`, while min/max additionally require `VK_EXT_shader_atomic_float2` and operation-specific min/max bits in non-Vulkan SC builds at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1156-L1221). |
| 64-bit floating-point atomics | `DATA_TYPE_FLOAT64` requires `VK_EXT_shader_atomic_float`; add and exchange check `shader*Float64AtomicAdd` or `shader*Float64Atomics`, while min/max additionally require `VK_EXT_shader_atomic_float2` and operation-specific min/max bits in non-Vulkan SC builds at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1223-L1288). |
| Buffer-reference cases | `_reference` cases require `VK_KHR_buffer_device_address` at [`AtomicOperationCase::checkSupport()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1290-L1293), allocate the main buffer with `VK_BUFFER_USAGE_SHADER_DEVICE_ADDRESS_BIT` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L907-L915), and pass its device address through a uniform buffer at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L918-L931). |
| Shader-stage availability | Every case calls `checkSupportShader(ctx, m_shaderType.getType())` after data/memory checks at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1295-L1296). |
| Mesh/task SPIR-V version | Mesh-shading stages select SPIR-V 1.4 build options before generating shader sources at [`AtomicOperationCase::initPrograms()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1019-L1028). |

## Verification Methods

- `AtomicOperationCaseInstance::iterate()` creates a typed [`BufferInterface`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L250-L258), fills it with deterministic random data using seed `0x62a15e34`, flushes the host-visible buffer, executes the generated shader, invalidates the buffer, and then calls `checkResults()` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L900-L1007).
- Integer buffers use exact byte comparison: [`Expected::compare()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L339-L344) compares final `inout`, first output, and second output with `deMemCmp()`, and failures are reported through `tcu::ResultCollector` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L627-L642).
- Floating-point buffers compare with `nanSafeSloppyEquals()` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L368-L378) and [`Expected::compare()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L473-L477). The tolerance is `0.00001` for the generic path and `0.01` for `deFloat16` at [`sloppyFPCompare()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L356-L366).
- Floating-point test data includes explicit signaling NaN, quiet NaN, and signed-zero cases at [`TestBufferFloatingPoint::fillWithTestData()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L412-L453), and min/max verification expands the acceptable NaN and signed-zero outcomes at [`handleExceptionalFloatMinMaxValues()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L646-L689).
- Both integer and floating-point verification accept legal non-determinism from two racing atomic operations per `inout` element: the integer path documents and checks two candidate outcomes at [`TestBuffer::checkOperation()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L524-L536), and the floating-point path does the same with a candidate vector at [`TestBufferFloatingPoint::checkOperationFloatingPoint()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L730-L742).
- Shared and payload cases use one workgroup with `NUM_ELEMENTS` local invocations, copy descriptor-backed data into shared-like storage before the atomic operation, and copy results back afterward using barriers at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1365-L1401) and [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1461-L1465). Non-shared-like cases execute `NUM_ELEMENTS` workgroups at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L995-L999).
- Fragment cases guard the atomic operation with `!gl_HelperInvocation`, while other non-vertex stages bound participation with `atomicAdd(invocationHitCount[0], 1) < N` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1375-L1390). Vertex cases use `gl_VertexIndex` and per-index hit counts at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1406-L1413).

## Test Principles

- The file uses a flat generated registration matrix rather than nested subgroups: `addAtomicOperationTests()` iterates operation, data type, shader stage, and memory type arrays, applies skip rules, and adds each resulting [`AtomicOperationCase`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1537-L1584).
- Operation coverage is intentionally narrower for floating-point data than for integer data. The source permits floating-point add and exchange in all builds, floating-point min/max only outside Vulkan SC, and excludes compare-swap and bitwise operations for floating-point data at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1543-L1557).
- Memory models are separated by suffix and shader declaration: ordinary buffers use a storage-buffer block, shared cases add a workgroup `shared` struct, payload cases add `taskPayloadSharedEXT`, and reference cases declare a `buffer_reference` plus a uniform containing the buffer reference at [`AtomicOperationCase::createShaderSpec()`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1320-L1357).
- Shader source generation enables only the extensions needed by the selected data and memory mode: 64-bit integer atomics, floating-point atomic extensions, optional NV 16-bit vector atomics, and buffer references are emitted at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1415-L1440).
- Correctness is based on host-side reconstruction of legal atomic results, not on API-call success alone: the instance executes the shader and always delegates pass/fail to `testBuffer->checkResults(resultCollector)` at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L999-L1007).

## Notes / Uncertainties

- The parseable hierarchy lists the non-Vulkan SC direct children produced by the visible registration arrays and skip rules. In Vulkan SC builds, the 16-bit floating-point data entries and floating-point min/max cases guarded by `#ifndef CTS_USES_VULKANSC` are not generated at [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1503-L1510) and [`vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp`](../../../modules/vulkan/shaderexecutor/vktAtomicOperationTests.cpp#L1549-L1553).
- The inspected source proves the generated naming pattern and support gates; no external registration-list prose is used as user-facing factual evidence.
